items.title: IDWeek 2026: early ensitrelvir PEP may benefit breakthrough and established Covid-19
items.summary: At IDWeek 2026, Akimasa Fukushi from Shionogi presented a subpopulation analysis of the Phase III SCORPIO-PEP trial.

items.title: IDWeek 2026: ISL/LEN on track to become the first once-weekly oral HIV therapy
items.summary: At IDWeek 2026, Samir K Gupta presented a pooled analysis of the Phase III ISLEND-1 and ISLEND-2 trials evaluating once-weekly ISL/LEN in adults with virologically suppressed HIV.

items.title: Prediction markets herald insider trading risks for private biotechs
items.summary: Legal experts say that pharma outcome bets on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket pose new insider trading risks.

items.title: Casgevy gains UK label expansion for younger patient population
items.summary: Following this MHRA label expansion, UK patients with β-thalassemia and sickle cell disease aged five and up can now receive Casgevy.

items.title: Eli Lilly’s tirzepatide outperforms big pharma companies in Q3
items.summary: Sales for Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound topped $16bn, exceeding total revenue for many big pharma players.
